amazon_india.verification_level: Official public Seller Central help pages reviewed
rules: Main image: pure white RGB 255,255,255 background.
Main image: show the whole product and product should occupy about 85% of the image area.
Main image: show one unit and only accessories included with the product; no unrelated props.
Main image: no added text, seller logo, watermark, border, colour block or graphic.
All images: accurately represent the product and match the listing title.
Image longest side: 500–10,000 px; images over 1,000 px on the longest side support zoom / are recommended.
Accepted formats per current guide: JPEG, TIFF, PNG and non-animated GIF; JPEG recommended; RGB preferred.
Category-specific requirements may apply; verify in Seller Central before upload.
amazon_india.notes: Amazon's public India help documentation is detailed. AI analysis is advisory, not an Amazon upload pre-check or approval.

flipkart.verification_level: Official Seller Hub guide link identified; detailed content may require Seller Hub access
rules: Use the official Image Guidelines and Image Uploading guide in Flipkart Seller Hub for current category-specific requirements.

Flipkart's public AutoQC engineering article describes checks for clear images, centered products, product coverage (at least 70% in its stated example), appropriate content and image/product-detail consistency.

Do not treat an old/public example as the current universal rule for every category. Mark exact technical requirements that cannot be verified from the accessible official guide as VERIFY_IN_SELLER_HUB.
flipkart.notes: The official guide is linked from the Seller Hub sitemap, but its public page may render only a JS shell. The auditor must not invent format, dimensions, image-count or overlay rules where current category-specific text cannot be read.
